user.title: Enter API Key
user.description: Enter your Google Maps Platform API key. Make sure the Weather API is enabled in your Google Cloud project.

data_description.api_key: Your Google Maps Platform API key with Weather API enabled

location.title: Configure Location
location.description: Configure the location and settings for Google Weather. The location will default to your Home Assistant configuration.

data_description.location: Location name used for entity IDs (default: 'home'). Examples: 'home', 'office', 'gw_home'
data_description.latitude: Latitude coordinate for weather data (defaults to Home Assistant location)
data_description.longitude: Longitude coordinate for weather data (defaults to Home Assistant location)

forecasts.title: Configure Forecast Options
forecasts.description:
Current conditions and daily forecasts are always included. Select additional features below.

Disable features to save API calls. Weather alerts are unavailable in some regions.

The minute forecast is alpha, and its call usage depends on the weather.

data.include_minute_forecast: Include Minute Forecast (Alpha - likely to change)

data_description.include_alerts: Enable weather alerts (unavailable in some regions)
data_description.include_minute_forecast: Experimental six-hour rain nowcast: when rain starts, stops and how much. Polling is started and stopped by the daily or hourly forecast you already fetch, so it stays quiet on dry days. May still take you over the 10,000 free calls/month - cost depends on the weather. Pre-GA, so entities may change. Off by default.

intervals.title: Configure Update Intervals
intervals.description: Set how often to update each endpoint during day and night. Google provides 10,000 free API calls/month total. The defaults use approximately 8,640 calls/month (13.6% under limit). All intervals are in minutes.

data.minute_min_interval: Minute Forecast - Minimum Time Between Calls (minutes)
data.minute_rain_threshold: Minute Forecast - Rain Probability To Start Polling (%)

data_description.current_day_interval: How often to update current conditions during daytime (default: 10 min)
data_description.current_night_interval: How often to update current conditions at night (default: 30 min)
data_description.daily_day_interval: How often to update daily forecast during daytime (default: 30 min)
data_description.daily_night_interval: How often to update daily forecast at night (default: 60 min)
data_description.hourly_day_interval: How often to update hourly forecast during daytime (default: 20 min)
data_description.hourly_night_interval: How often to update hourly forecast at night (default: 60 min)
data_description.alerts_day_interval: How often to check weather alerts during daytime (default: 15 min)
data_description.alerts_night_interval: How often to check weather alerts at night (default: 30 min)
data_description.night_start: When nighttime update schedule begins (e.g., 22:00 for 10 PM)
data_description.night_end: When nighttime update schedule ends (e.g., 06:00 for 6 AM)
data_description.minute_min_interval: Shortest gap between calls, used while rain falls. This is not the forecast's resolution, which is regional and fixed by Google: 2-minute segments in the US, 15-minute elsewhere so far. Polling faster than your region's segments gets revisions sooner but no finer an answer. Biggest influence on cost: in a temperate climate roughly 1,480 calls/month at 2, 750 at 5, 500 at 10. 5 is balanced; pick 10 or more in a wet climate, or match your region's segments.
data_description.minute_rain_threshold: Rain probability at which the nowcast starts polling, read from the hourly forecast or the daily blocks when hourly is off. Below it the nowcast goes quiet and only checks every few hours. Unrelated to the nowcast's own probability field.
data_description.minute_monthly_budget: Past this many calls in a month, the nowcast slows to two-hourly. A safeguard, not a guarantee: it resets on restart and cannot see other users of your API key.

error.invalid_api_key: Invalid API key or Weather API not enabled. Please check your Google Cloud Console.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Google Weather API. Please check your network connection.

get_forecast.name: Get forecast on demand
get_forecast.description: Fetch weather forecast on demand, even when automatic polling is disabled. This service makes a single API call to fetch the requested forecast type.

entity_id.name: Entity ID
entity_id.description: The weather entity ID to fetch forecasts for.

forecast_type.name: Forecast type
forecast_type.description: Type of forecast to fetch (daily, hourly, or minute).
